title: structured_data_fetch input
description: Read structured datasets or Stage1 rollups. listVersions and version are dataset-only; kind mode rejects these options with structured_data_fetch-specific OODS-V202.

dataset.description: Local structured dataset to return (components/tokens/manifest). Mutually exclusive with kind+runPath.

kind.description: Stage1 artifact kind, with runPath; excludes dataset. Admits run_manifest through 1.8.0, a11y_report 2.2.0–2.5.0 and 3.0.0, drift_report 1.0.0–1.4.0 and 2.0.0, report_index 1.0.0/1.1.0 and a11y_evidence 1.1.0–1.4.0. derived_analysis admits analysis 1.0.0/1.1.0, fig_local_tokens 1.0.0/1.3.0/1.5.0/1.6.0 and style_fingerprint 1.3.0/1.4.0, with retained-file digests, lineage and JSON Pointer checks. Earlier admitted versions remain readable; unknown versions and suite roots are refused.

runPath.description: Filesystem path to a Stage1 run directory or its artifacts/ subdirectory. Required when kind is set.

ifNoneMatch.description: Return matched=true without payload when the ETag matches.

includePayload.description: When false, omit payload even if no ETag match occurs.

version.description: Request a specific date-stamped version (e.g., '2026-02-24'). Omit for latest. Applies to dataset mode only.

listVersions.description: When true, return available version dates instead of payload.

includeInternal.description: Live components dataset only: also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them; a dated export is served unchanged.

payloadMode.description: Unset: inline, unless the payload exceeds 100,000 characters; then it is written to a file and warning OODS-W004 says so. inline always returns it; file always writes it and returns payloadFile.

detail.description: Dataset only. summary returns section counts and the call for page 1; full (default) preserves the dataset.

page.description: Dataset only: read a 1-based page of lossless JSON Pointer entries, each reply below 100,000 characters. Omit for full data.

pageSize.description: Dataset entries per page, default 10, also bounded by serialized size. Reply meta gives next and full calls.
